chapters.title: How We Met
chapters.body: Replace this with the story of how you two met. Two or three sentences read best on a phone screen — keep it short, let the photo carry the rest.

chapters.title: The First Date
chapters.body: Replace with a memory from your first date. What did you notice about her? What made you nervous?

chapters.title: Made It Official
chapters.body: Replace with the moment you two became a couple.

chapters.title: Meeting the Family
chapters.body: Optional chapter — delete this entry if it doesn't apply yet. Replace with the story of meeting each other's family/friends for the first time, and how it went.

chapters.title: A Favorite Trip
chapters.body: Replace with a memory from a trip, a small outing, anything that stuck with you both.

chapters.title: Getting Through It Together
chapters.body: Optional chapter — delete this entry if it doesn't feel right. Replace with a hard moment you two got through together, and what it showed you about each other. This one can carry more weight than the others; it's okay if it's shorter or heavier in tone.

chapters.title: The Inside Joke
chapters.body: Replace with the story behind a running joke only the two of you get.

chapters.title: A Random Tuesday
chapters.body: Optional chapter — a small, unremarkable, ordinary day that you remember anyway. Not a milestone, just a moment. These often mean the most; keep this one short.

finale.title: Today
finale.lockedHeadline: One more chapter is still being written.
finale.letterBody: Replace this with your anniversary letter to Camille — this is the emotional peak of the whole story, so take your time writing it. It can be as long as you want; it's the one chapter where more text is fine.
